title: KernelMosaic: An Open Dataset and Agentic Framework for CUDA Kernel Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14604v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training large language models to generate efficient CUDA kernels requires supervision spanning diverse computational requirements and iterative code optimization. Constructing this supervision is challenging because of heterogeneous specifications, and useful implementations emerge through iterative complicated testing and refinement. We introduce KernelMosaic, an open dataset pairing diverse CUDA tasks with verified solutions and trajectories. Human-guided review and diversity-aware selection curate tasks expressed as natural-language descriptions, reference programs, mathematical specifications, and their intersections. To build the solutions and trajectories, our agentic framework guides a strong LLM through implementation, correctness repair, and performance optimization with reusable CUDA guidance and execution feedback. translated_title: KernelMosaic：一个用于CUDA内核生成的开放数据集与智能体框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.14604v1 公告类型：cross。摘要：训练大型语言模型生成高效的CUDA内核需要跨越多样化计算需求和迭代式代码优化的监督数据。构建这类监督数据具有挑战性，因为规范说明形式各异（异构），而且有用的实现往往需要通过复杂的迭代测试与改进才能产生。我们提出了KernelMosaic，这是一个开放数据集，将多样化的CUDA任务与经过验证的解决方案及轨迹配对。通过人工引导的审查和注重多样性的筛选，我们精心整理了以自然语言描述、参考程序、数学规范及其组合形式表达的任务。为了构建解决方案和轨迹，我们的智能体框架借助可复用的CUDA指导信息和执行反馈，引导一个强大的LLM完成实现、正确性修复和性能优化。在KernelMosaic上对一个小的开源模型进行监督微调，将正确率从4%、0%和0%提升至……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: KernelMosaic是一个开放数据集与智能体框架，通过人工审核、多样性筛选以及智能体驱动的迭代实现、修复与优化流程，为训练LLM生成高效CUDA内核提供了多样化任务配对的验证解决方案与轨迹数据。
en_tdlr: KernelMosaic is an open dataset and agentic framework that curates diverse CUDA tasks paired with verified solutions and trajectories via human-guided review, diversity-aware selection, and agentic iterative implementation, repair, and optimization for training LLMs to generate efficient CUDA kernels.
